fullPassage:
Choosing a career is one of the biggest life decisions young people face. Mapping out the right career path can be demanding. While some teenagers have a clear vision of their career goals, others struggle to define them. This is where role models can be useful. They help young people start to plan their careers by providing them with guidance and the sense of purpose they need to succeed. We asked our teenage readers about their role models and the qualities they admire most in them. After you read each student's story, you will get a better idea of the profound impact role models can have when it comes to shaping career goals.

My role model is Jacques Cousteau, a famous ocean explorer. As a young boy, Cousteau was involved in a serious car accident, and doctors told him he might never use his arms again. However, he refused to give up. Following his doctors' advice, he started swimming as a way to strengthen his arms. It was during this recovery that he became intrigued by the underwater world. At the time, diving equipment was insufficient for deep exploration. This challenge inspired Cousteau to co-invent the Aqua-Lung, a device that allowed divers to breathe underwater for extended periods. He also produced a famous documentary that opened people's eyes to the beauty and fragility of ocean life. Cousteau became a leading figure in marine conservation. What I admire most about him is his curiosity and passion for pushing beyond boundaries.

My role model is Joan Beauchamp Procter, a pioneering British zoologist who devoted her life to the study of reptiles. From a young age, Procter showed a deep devotion to animals, especially reptiles. She was so immersed in her studies that she often brought her pet reptiles to school. Despite suffering from serious health problems throughout her life, she never let them hold her back. Procter gained extensive knowledge of reptiles, and at the age of just sixteen, she began exchanging letters with George Albert Boulenger, one of the most respected zoologists of that era. Impressed by her knowledge, Boulenger encouraged her to pursue a career in zoology. She went on to become the curator of the Reptile House at the London Zoo, where she transformed it into a world-class facility by incorporating technology and innovative design.

My role model is Kim Sang-jin, a Korean animator who worked at Disney. From a young age, Kim was enthusiastic about drawing and dreamed of becoming an animator. However, he was diagnosed with color vision deficiency, which disrupted his plans. Many people tried to discourage him from pursuing art, but he refused to give up. Instead, he earned an economics degree while continuing to develop his drawing skills. He built an impressive portfolio and eventually landed a position at Walt Disney Studios. What I admire most about Kim is his persistence and positive attitude. He never let obstacles define his future.

These stories show us the importance of having role models. Whether it is Cousteau's curiosity, Procter's devotion, or Kim's persistence, each of them demonstrates qualities that can inspire us. Their commitment and optimism teach us that career exploration is a journey, not a destination. Role models remind us that with hard work and dedication, we can achieve our goals.

questions.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: 원문 순서: 사고 → 포기 거부+수영 → 수중 세계 흥미+아쿠아렁 → 다큐멘터리+해양보전
det.correct: ✅ (B)-(A)-(C): (B) 포기 거부+수영 시작 → (A) 회복 중 수중 세계 흥미+아쿠아렁 발명 → (C) 다큐멘터리+해양보전
det.tip: However(역접) → this recovery(지시어) → He also(추가) 순서로 연결. (B)의 However가 사고 소식에 대한 반응, (A)의 this recovery가 (B)의 수영을 가리킨다.
det.analysis:
✅ (B)-(A)-(C): However(역접)가 사고 소식에 대한 반응 → this recovery가 수영 시작을 가리킴 → He also가 추가 업적 나열
❌ (A)-(B)-(C): this recovery가 가리킬 선행사가 없어 부자연스러움
❌ (B)-(C)-(A): He also가 (B) 직후에 오면 아쿠아렁 발명이 빠짐
❌ (C)-(A)-(B): 다큐 제작이 사고 직후에 나오면 시간 순서 붕괴

questions.stem:
다음 글에서 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

"Instead, he earned an economics degree while continuing to develop his drawing skills."

det.ref: 원문 위치: refused to give up 직후, built an impressive portfolio 직전
det.correct: ✅ ③: 포기를 거부한 후(refused to give up) '대신(Instead)' 경제학 학위를 따면서 그림 실력을 키웠다. 이후 포트폴리오를 만든 것이 자연스럽다.
det.tip: Instead는 앞의 행동(포기)의 대안을 제시. refused to give up → Instead(대신) → built portfolio 순서.
det.korean: 어린 시절부터 Kim은 그림 그리기에 열정적이었고 애니메이터가 되는 것을 꿈꿨다. 그러나 색각 이상 진단을 받았다. 많은 사람들이 예술 추구를 단념시키려 했지만, 포기하기를 거부했다. [삽입] 대신, 경제학 학위를 따면서 그림 실력을 계속 키워나갔다. 인상적인 포트폴리오를 만들어 월트 디즈니 스튜디오에 취직했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ②: refused to give up(포기 거부) 직후 Instead(대신)가 자연스럽게 연결됨. 경제학 학위+그림 실력 → 포트폴리오로 이어짐
❌ ①: 열정 직후에 Instead가 오면 맥락 부자연스러움
❌ ③: 색각 이상 진단과 단념 사이에 경제학 학위가 끼어들면 시간순 어색
❌ ④: 이미 디즈니에 취직한 후 경제학 학위를 따는 것은 순서 역전

questions.stem:
다음 글에서 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

"It was during this recovery that he became intrigued by the underwater world."

det.ref: 원문 위치: 수영 시작 직후, 장비 부족 직전
det.correct: ✅ ②: 수영으로 회복하는 중(this recovery = 수영을 통한 팔 강화)에 수중 세계에 흥미를 느꼈다. this recovery가 앞 문장의 swimming을 가리킨다.
det.tip: this recovery(이 회복)는 바로 앞의 swimming as a way to strengthen his arms를 가리킨다. 지시어 추적이 핵심.
det.korean: 나의 롤모델은 유명한 해양 탐험가 자크 쿠스토이다. 어린 소년 시절 심각한 자동차 사고에 연루되었다. 포기를 거부하고 수영을 시작했다. [삽입] 바로 이 회복 기간 동안 수중 세계에 흥미를 느끼게 되었다. 당시 잠수 장비는 심해 탐험에 불충분했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ①: this recovery가 앞의 swimming(수영을 통한 회복)을 가리킴. 수영 시작 → 회복 중 흥미 → 장비 부족 순서 자연스러움
❌ ②: 사고 직후에 this recovery가 오면 가리킬 회복 과정이 없음
❌ ③: 장비 부족 이후에 오면 시간순 역행
❌ ④: 아쿠아렁 발명 후에 수중 세계 흥미가 오면 인과관계 역전

you will get of the profound impact a better idea role models can have

det.correct: ✅ ①: get a better idea of(~에 대해 더 잘 이해하다) + the profound impact(심오한 영향) + role models can have(롤모델이 미칠 수 있는)
det.tip: get a better idea of ~: ~에 대해 더 잘 이해하다. the profound impact (that) role models can have: 관계절이 impact를 수식.

she transformed it by incorporating into a world-class facility technology and innovative design
she transformed it into a world-class facility by incorporating technology and innovative design
she by incorporating technology and innovative design transformed it into a world-class facility

det.correct: ✅ ③: transform A into B(A를 B로 변환하다) + by + 동명사(~함으로써)
det.tip: transform A into B: A를 B로 탈바꿈시키다. by incorporating: ~을 도입함으로써. by + 동명사 = 수단/방법.

❌ ③: by incorporating 뒤에 into가 와서 incorporate의 목적어가 불분명

At the time, diving equipment was ⓒ<u>insufficient</u> for deep exploration. questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓓ 중 어법상 어색한 것은?

det.ref: 원문: a device that allowed divers
det.correct: ✅ ⓓ allowing → allowed: 관계대명사 that 뒤에 동사가 필요. 주절의 과거 시제(inspired)에 맞춰 과거형 allowed가 적절.
wrongs: ⓐ told: 과거시제, tell + 간접목적어 + 직접목적어 정상
ⓑ became: became intrigued(흥미를 느끼게 되다) 정상
det.tip: 관계대명사절의 동사! that + 동사(allowed). allowing(현재분사)은 관계절의 동사로 부적절. a device that allowed(허용한 장치).
det.analysis:
✅ ⓓ allowing → allowed: 관계대명사 that의 동사 자리에 현재분사(allowing)는 부적절. 과거형 allowed가 올바름

questions.passage:
Choosing a career is one of the biggest life decisions young people face. Mapping out the right career path can be demanding. While some teenagers have a clear vision of their career goals, others struggle to define them. This is where role models can be useful. They help young people start to plan their careers by providing them with guidance and the sense of purpose they need to succeed. We asked our teenage readers about their role models and the qualities they admire most in them. After you read each student's story, you will get a better idea of the profound impact role models can have when it comes to shaping career goals.

My role model is Jacques Cousteau, a famous ocean explorer. As a young boy, Cousteau was involved in a serious car accident, and doctors told him he might never use his arms again. However, he refused to give up. Following his doctors' advice, he started swimming as a way to strengthen his arms. It was during this recovery that he became intrigued by the underwater world. At the time, diving equipment was insufficient for deep exploration. This challenge inspired Cousteau to co-invent the Aqua-Lung, a device that allowed divers to breathe underwater for extended periods. He also produced a famous documentary that opened people's eyes to the beauty and fragility of ocean life. Cousteau became a leading figure in marine conservation. What I admire most about him is his curiosity and passion for pushing beyond boundaries.

My role model is Joan Beauchamp Procter, a pioneering British zoologist who devoted her life to the study of reptiles. From a young age, Procter showed a deep devotion to animals, especially reptiles. She was so immersed in her studies that she often brought her pet reptiles to school. Despite suffering from serious health problems throughout her life, she never let them hold her back. Procter gained extensive knowledge of reptiles, and at the age of just sixteen, she began exchanging letters with George Albert Boulenger, one of the most respected zoologists of that era. Impressed by her knowledge, Boulenger encouraged her to pursue a career in zoology. She went on to become the curator of the Reptile House at the London Zoo, where she transformed it into a world-class facility by incorporating technology and innovative design.

My role model is Kim Sang-jin, a Korean animator who worked at Disney. From a young age, Kim was enthusiastic about drawing and dreamed of becoming an animator. However, he was diagnosed with color vision deficiency, which disrupted his plans. Many people tried to discourage him from pursuing art, but he refused to give up. Instead, he earned an economics degree while continuing to develop his drawing skills. He built an impressive portfolio and eventually landed a position at Walt Disney Studios. What I admire most about Kim is his persistence and positive attitude. He never let obstacles define his future.

These stories show us the importance of having role models. Whether it is Cousteau's curiosity, Procter's devotion, or Kim's persistence, each of them demonstrates qualities that can inspire us. Their commitment and optimism teach us that career exploration is a journey, not a destination. Role models remind us that with hard work and dedication, we can achieve our goals.
questions.stem: 위 글의 Kim Sang-jin에 관한 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 주변 사람들이 그의 예술 추구를 격려했다.

det.ref: 원문: he was diagnosed with color vision deficiency
det.correct: ✅ ① 색각 이상(color vision deficiency) 진단 — 원문 직접 언급
wrongs: ② 미술 대학이 아니라 경제학(economics) 학위
④ 픽사가 아니라 월트 디즈니(Walt Disney) 스튜디오
det.tip: color vision deficiency = 색각 이상(색맹/색약). 원문 정보와 선지의 세부 사항을 정확히 대조해야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 색각 이상 진단: 원문 'diagnosed with color vision deficiency' 직접 언급
❌ ② 미술 대학 학위: 경제학(economics) 학위이지 미술 대학이 아님
❌ ③ 예술 추구 격려: 격려(encourage)가 아니라 단념시키려(discourage) 했음
❌ ④ 픽사 스튜디오: 픽사가 아니라 월트 디즈니(Walt Disney) 스튜디오
